name: Gentle Meditation
intro: Welcome. You've chosen to be here, and that matters.
Let your eyes close softly, or simply lower your gaze.
There is nothing to fix right now. Nothing to solve.
Just breathe. In through your nose... and out through your mouth.
Let each breath be a little slower than the last.
You are exactly where you need to be.
body: Bring your attention to the weight of your body.
Feel the places where you're supported. The ground beneath you. The surface holding you.
You don't have to hold yourself up right now. Let gravity do the work.
If thoughts come, let them pass like clouds. You don't need to follow them.
Just notice them... and return to your breath.
Now gently scan your body from the top of your head downward.
Notice your forehead. Your jaw. Are you holding tension there?
If so, just notice it. No judgment. Simply soften.
Let your shoulders drop. Let your hands relax.
Each exhale is permission to release a little more.
Imagine a warm, soft light resting just above your head.
With each breath, it slowly moves downward through your body.
It touches your face and your expression softens.
It moves through your chest, your arms, your hands.
Wherever it goes, tension dissolves into warmth.
Now let your awareness settle on your heartbeat.
You don't need to find it. Just know it's there. Steady. Faithful.
It has been beating for you since before you were born.
Without asking anything in return.
Take a moment to feel gratitude for that quiet rhythm.
In this stillness, there is nothing missing.
You are whole. You are safe. You are enough.
Let yourself rest in this knowing.
There's nowhere else to be. Nothing else to do.
Just this moment. Just this breath. Just you.
closing: Gently now, begin to deepen your breath.
Feel the room around you. The sounds. The air on your skin.
There's no rush. Take your time coming back.
Wiggle your fingers. Your toes. A small movement to reconnect.
When you're ready, open your eyes softly.
Carry this stillness with you. It's always here when you need it.
